messages.subject: Harledge / Pennine covenant breach - need your help urgently
messages.plaintextBody:
Sarah,

As flagged on the call, we've tripped both the leverage and DSCR covenants at the September quarter-end. Pennine's restructuring team are circling and we need a standstill while we put a plan together. Can you take this on? Robert wants us moving this week.

Fiona

Fiona Carrick | CFO | Harledge Foods Group Limited

messages.subject: RE: Harledge / Pennine covenant breach - need your help urgently
messages.plaintextBody:
Fiona,

Yes, we'd be glad to act. I've attached our engagement letter setting out scope, team and fees - James Osei will run the day-to-day with Elena Marchetti supporting. Please sign and return and we'll get straight onto the standstill with Pennine.

We should also schedule a short call on directors' duties given where things are.

Sarah

Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
This email is confidential and may be legally privileged.
